title: Roadbone Gnawer
text: Roadbone Gnawer rips marker posts from the route and sharpens its teeth on their iron cores. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: It eats the map before it eats the traveler.

defeatReward.text: Roadbone Gnawer is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
